results.question: Total revenue per region in Q3
results.sql: SELECT region, SUM(revenue) FROM sales WHERE quarter = 'Q3' GROUP BY region
results.reference: SELECT region, SUM(revenue) FROM sales WHERE quarter='Q3' GROUP BY region

results.question: Which product sold the most units overall?
results.sql: SELECT product, SUM(units) FROM sales GROUP BY product ORDER BY SUM(units) DESC LIMIT 1
results.reference: SELECT product FROM sales GROUP BY product ORDER BY SUM(units) DESC LIMIT 1

results.question: How many sales rows are there?
What is the total revenue across all rows?
Show every sale with revenue above 40000, highest first
results.sql: SELECT * FROM sales WHERE revenue > 40000 ORDER BY revenue DESC
results.reference: SELECT * FROM sales WHERE revenue>40000 ORDER BY revenue DESC

results.question: Average units sold per product
results.sql: SELECT product, AVG(units) FROM sales GROUP BY product
results.reference: SELECT product, AVG(units) FROM sales GROUP BY product

results.question: How many books did each author write? Show the author name.
results.sql: SELECT a.name, COUNT(b.author_id) FROM authors a JOIN books b ON a.author_id = b.author_id GROUP BY a.name
results.reference: SELECT a.name, COUNT(b.book_id) FROM authors a JOIN books b ON a.author_id=b.author_id GROUP BY a.name

results.question: Which books are currently on loan? Show the title.
results.sql: SELECT b.title FROM books b JOIN loans l ON b.book_id = l.book_id WHERE l.returned = 0
results.reference: SELECT DISTINCT b.title FROM books b JOIN loans l ON b.book_id=l.book_id WHERE l.returned=0

results.question: Count loans per author country
results.sql: SELECT a.country, COUNT(l.loan_id) FROM authors a JOIN books b ON a.author_id = b.author_id JOIN loans l ON b.book_id = l.book_id GROUP BY a.country
results.reference: SELECT a.country, COUNT(*) FROM loans l JOIN books b ON l.book_id=b.book_id JOIN authors a ON b.author_id=a.author_id GROUP BY a.country

results.question: List book titles published before 1975
results.sql: SELECT title FROM books WHERE year < 1975
results.reference: SELECT title FROM books WHERE year<1975

results.question: Which authors are from the USA?
results.sql: SELECT name FROM authors WHERE country = 'USA'
results.reference: SELECT name FROM authors WHERE country='USA'

results.question: Average visit cost by department, highest first
results.sql: SELECT department, AVG(cost) as avg_cost FROM visits GROUP BY department ORDER BY avg_cost DESC
results.reference: SELECT department, AVG(cost) AS a FROM visits GROUP BY department ORDER BY a DESC

results.question: Which patients have more than one visit? Show their names.
results.sql: SELECT name FROM patients WHERE patient_id IN (SELECT patient_id FROM visits GROUP BY patient_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1)
results.reference: SELECT p.name FROM patients p JOIN visits v ON p.patient_id=v.patient_id GROUP BY p.name HAVING COUNT(*)>1

results.question: Total spend per city
results.sql: SELECT city, SUM(cost) FROM visits JOIN patients ON visits.patient_id = patients.patient_id GROUP BY city
results.reference: SELECT p.city, SUM(v.cost) FROM visits v JOIN patients p ON v.patient_id=p.patient_id GROUP BY p.city

results.question: How many visits were there in total?
Departments whose average visit cost is above the overall average
results.sql: SELECT department, AVG(cost) as avg_cost FROM visits GROUP BY department HAVING avg_cost > (SELECT AVG(cost) FROM visits)
results.reference: SELECT department FROM visits GROUP BY department HAVING AVG(cost) > (SELECT AVG(cost) FROM visits)

results.question: List patients born before 1980
results.sql: SELECT name FROM patients WHERE birth_year < 1980
results.reference: SELECT name FROM patients WHERE birth_year<1980
